facts.material: electronic/optical instrument (camera and light source, electrical)
facts.function: measures particle size and shape of dry bulk solids by dynamic image analysis
facts.end_use: laboratory/industrial physical analysis of powders and granules

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9027 covers instruments for physical or chemical analysis; chapter 90 note 1 exclusions do not apply

GRI 6: 9027.50 instruments using optical radiations (visible light imaging), then 9027.50.40 electrical, then 'Other' 9027.50.40.60 since it is neither chemical analysis, thermal analysis nor a photometer

rejected_alternatives.reason: chemical analysis instrument; particle size/shape is physical analysis
9027 specifically covers physical analysis instruments; measuring optical instruments of 9031 are for items not covered elsewhere
the instrument works by imaging with optical radiation, so 9027.50 is more apt than the residual 'other instruments'

missing_facts: whether the measurement principle is optical imaging (assumed yes from 'image analysis')
classification.rationale: A dynamic image analyzer uses a camera and illumination to determine particle size and shape, an electrical instrument using optical radiation for physical analysis, so heading 9027 and subheading 9027.50.40. The residual 'Other' statistical line applies. Similar analyzer rulings seen in search (for example N342063) were on different products and were not relied on.
